note: The realm root; upload big.txt (150 KiB: a content part, then the name), then the same bytes into docs/ while the first is confirming. Its content part is the same publication, so the SDK holds the save back (ALREADY_ATTEMPTED, its twin the first save): the review says an earlier save with the same contents is still confirming, and Send waits. After 64 blocks the first is final, and Send sends the second (its content part goes out again, then the name).
steps: Open the realm root; connect as anvil #6
Upload big.txt at the root: two parts, two sends; Saved · confirming
The same bytes into docs/: held back (ALREADY_ATTEMPTED); its new save stopped
64 blocks later, the saves check again: the first save is final
Send: a new save, both parts sent; big.txt is listed in docs/
